layout: StickerCube (src/lib/cube/stickerCube.ts): faces U R F D L B, 9 stickers each, row by row as seen from outside; U with B at the top, D with F at the top, side faces with U at the top. Colour k is the colour of face k in the WCA scrambling orientation (white U, green F).

input.size: 192 for the full reader, its own size for the lite one (cube-reader.json: variants.<kind>.size)
input.range: 0..1, NCHW float32; the model normalizes internally
input.crop: square crop of the cube: the detector's box times 1.5 (else findCube, src/lib/vision/roi.ts), area-averaged

outputs.present: [N, 6] probability that the face whose centre has colour k can be read
outputs.stickers: [N, 6, 9, 7] per face k and cell i: probabilities of the 6 colours and of 'hidden'. Cells are in StickerCube order up to an unknown rotation of the face (0, 90, 180, 270 degrees); the centre cell (4) is the face colour
outputs.turning: [N, 1] probability that a layer is between two positions (frame to be ignored)
outputs.orientation: [N, 3, 3] rotation taking the WCA directions of the centres (white +y, red +x, green +z) to where they point in the camera's frame (x right, y up, z towards the viewer), for the crop given

detector.input: the whole frame letterboxed into a 320×320 square (longer side fitted, grey 0.5 bars), RGB 0..1, NCHW
detector.outputs: box [N, 4]: the whole cube's box (hidden pieces included), x0 y0 x1 y1 as shares of the square, may pass its edges; score [N, 1]
detector.crop: the reader's crop: a square of the box's longer side times cropMargin (1.5) around its centre
detector.zoom: a cube under 25 % of the frame's longer side (or, when none is found, the box followed so far) is detected again in a square of 4 times its box around it, letterboxed the same way, grey past the frame's edges (src/lib/vision/detector.ts)

models.metadata: public/models/cube-reader.json: input name, and for each variant (full, lite) its file and input size
